title: Move the camera closer to the character

posts.author: LeRoiManlo
posts.body: Hello, I find that the basic camera is quite far from the player. I would like to know if it was possible to bring it closer, to zoom permanently among other things and if so how to do it. I also thought that I could simply increase the size of my sprites but I like to keep the pixel art aspect so the more I increase the more I lose this aspect. If despite everything it is the only solution what format would you advise me as a beginner and why? Thank you!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
There are plenty of solutions for this, if you Google "rpg maker mz zoom plugin" you should find several options (I see one from Hakuen Studio, one from VisuStella, and a couple posted here in threads).
